objects.constraint public.notification_email_sen: CHECK (((workflow_reservation_id IS NULL) OR (recipient_hash IS NOT NULL)))
objects.constraint public.workflow_enrollments.w: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id, organization_id) REFERENCES bookings(id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((((occurrence = 'created'::text) AND (trigger = ANY (ARRAY['booking.created'::text, 'before_start'::text, 'after_end'::text]))) OR ((occurrence = 'rescheduled'::text) AND (trigger = 'booking.rescheduled'::text)) OR ((occurrence = 'cancelled'::text) AND (trigger = 'booking.cancelled'::text))))
objects.constraint public.workflow_mail_reservat: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES auth.organization(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.workflow_recipient_cla: CHECK (((((intent_kind IS NULL) AND (intent_offset_minutes IS NULL)) OR ((intent_kind = ANY (ARRAY['before_start'::text, 'after_end'::text])) AND ((intent_offset_minutes >= 5) AND (intent_offset_minutes <= 43200)))) IS TRUE))
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, run_id, booking_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs(organization_id, id, booking_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK (((attempts >= 0) AND (
CASE
    WHEN (state = 'pending'::text) THEN (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, claim_token, finished_at) = 0)
    WHEN (state = 'dispatching'::text) THEN ((claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, next_attempt_at, finished_at) = 0))
    WHEN (state = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'delivery_unknown'::text])) THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, claim_token, next_attempt_at) = 0))
    WHEN (state = 'skipped'::text) THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(claim_token, next_attempt_at) = 0) AND (skip_reason = ANY (ARRAY['condition_false'::text, 'existing_notification'::text, 'minimum_gap'::text, 'offset_not_future'::text, 'expired'::text, 'budget_suppressed'::text, 'render_limit'::text, 'workflow_disabled'::text, 'instance_disabled'::text])))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE)))
objects.constraint public.workflow_run_history.w: CHECK ((((revision >= 1) AND (LEAST(sent, rejected, delivery_unknown, skipped) >= 0) AND (((outcome = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'retired'::text])) AND (reason IS NULL)) OR ((outcome = 'skipped'::text) AND (reason = ANY (ARRAY['condition_false'::text, 'existing_notification'::text, 'minimum_gap'::text, 'offset_not_future'::text, 'expired'::text, 'budget_suppressed'::text, 'render_limit'::text, 'workflow_disabled'::text, 'instance_disabled'::text]))))) IS TRUE))
FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, workflow_id) REFERENCES workflow_definitions(organization_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
objects.constraint public.workflow_runs.workflow: FOREIGN KEY (organization_id, enrollment_id, booking_id) REFERENCES workflow_enrollments(organization_id, id, booking_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

CHECK ((
CASE
    WHEN (state = 'pending'::text) THEN (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, claim_token, lease_until, finished_at) = 0)
    WHEN (state = 'claimed'::text) THEN ((claim_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, finished_at) = 0))
    WHEN (state = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'retired'::text])) THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(skip_reason, claim_token, lease_until) = 0))
    WHEN (state = 'skipped'::text) THEN ((finished_at IS NOT NULL) AND (num_nonnulls(claim_token, lease_until) = 0) AND (skip_reason = ANY (ARRAY['condition_false'::text, 'existing_notification'::text, 'minimum_gap'::text, 'offset_not_future'::text, 'expired'::text, 'budget_suppressed'::text, 'render_limit'::text, 'workflow_disabled'::text, 'instance_disabled'::text])))
    ELSE false
END IS TRUE))
